summary: Frontend-only smoke of the 5 new/updated flows on top of Super Mart. All 5 flows pass end-to-end. (1) /mart: 82 material cards each render a category image (unsplash) at the top; mart-trend-btn opens mart-trend-dialog which renders a Recharts LineChart (SVG present) inside [data-testid=mart-trend-chart], along with a % change badge (e.g. '▲ 10.2% (6 mo)') and a buy-timing note ('Prices are trending up — consider buying sooner.'). (2) Login /login: forgot-password-link switches stage to 'forgot', forgot-email + forgot-submit visible; submitting customer@buildecogroup.com shows forgot-sent 'If an account exists for customer@buildecogroup.com, a reset link has been emailed…'. Normal login with demo customer credential works. (3) Customer MaterialCalculator: nav → Material Calc → template-bar visible; template-select loads 3 templates ['3BHK Villa · ~1800 sqft (12 items)', '2BHK Flat · ~1000 sqft (8 items)', 'Boundary Wall · 100 rft × 6 ft (5 items)']; selecting 3BHK Villa + Generate BOQ populates exactly 12 calc-line rows and calc-total shows ₹9,05,900 (matches backend spec ~905900). (4) Contractor BOQ template: contractor login → BOQ tab → project 'Mart Test Villa' preselected → boq-template-select has 3 options; selecting 3BHK Villa + boq-template-load POSTs 12 lines to /api/erp/boq → BOQ rows increased from 4→16 (i.e. +12 new template rows) and Total BOQ Value updated to ₹9,91,865; boq-pdf-btn opens a new browser tab (PDF window captured via context.expect_page). (5) Billing pay-with-card: customer already on Business plan (subscribe btn disabled = idempotent), 2 unpaid invoices present; clicking invoice-pay-<id> triggers POST /api/payments/invoice-checkout and browser navigates to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... (Stripe checkout URL confirmed via request interception; did NOT complete card entry per instructions).

issues: Console warning: Recharts LineChart complains 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' at initial mount (transient — chart still renders correctly once dialog is visible). Consider giving the ResponsiveContainer parent a fixed initial minWidth/minHeight or defer render until dialog open animation completes.
Console warning: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}' on mart-trend-dialog (a11y). Add DialogDescription or aria-describedby.

Same hydration warning as iteration_7 — platform instrumentation injects <span> inside <option> from templates.map and mart materials.map. Not functional, but noisy. Move display string to a plain String() child (already flagged in iter7).

action_items: (a11y, LOW) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Mart trend dialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
(LOW) Fix Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warning by rendering LineChart only after dialog transition or setting explicit chart size.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.jsx forgot flow is UI-only success — backend forgot-password returns ok regardless of whether the account exists (correct, prevents user enumeration). Good.

MaterialCalculator template-load merges template lines into `lines` state — but there is no de-duplication: clicking Generate twice will produce 24 lines with duplicate keys risk. Consider key = crypto.randomUUID() or tpl+idx+timestamp. Currently OK because each item uses tpl id + index and Math.random-based keys, but verify.

ContractorDashboard boq-template-load fires 12 sequential POSTs to /api/erp/boq. This is O(n) round-trips per template — a single POST /api/erp/boq/bulk would be far faster; the 6-second sleep in the test hints at slowness. Consider batch endpoint.

BillingSection pay() uses window.location.href assignment; works, but on failure (non-JSON error, network) there is no toast/rollback state — user just sees no navigation. Verify error path shows a toast.
mart-trend-dialog LineChart passes m.rate_history directly; if backend ever returns fewer than 2 points, the chart would degenerate. Consider guarding with rate_history.length >= 2 before rendering.
